lines.text: India grows about 20 billion coconuts a year. Which shells sell?
lines.tts: India grows about twenty billion coconuts a year. Which shells sell?
lines.phonemes: ˈɪndiə ɡɹˈoʊz ɐbˌaʊt twˈɛnti bˈɪliən kˈoʊkənˌʌts ɐ jˈɪɹ. wˌɪtʃ ʃˈɛlz sˈɛl?

lines.text: A Kerala shell-craft firm exported 40,000 pieces to Denmark.
lines.tts: A Kerala shell craft firm exported forty thousand pieces to Denmark.
lines.phonemes: ɐ kˈɛɹələ ʃˈɛl kɹˈæft fˈɜːm ɛkspˈɔːɹɾᵻd fˈɔːɹɾi θˈaʊzənd pˈiːsᵻz tə dˈɛnmɑːɹk.

lines.text: Sand an uncracked half, polish it with coconut oil, drill a drain, add a rope.
lines.phonemes: sˈænd ɐn ʌŋkɹˈækt hˈæf, pˈɑːlɪʃ ɪt wɪð kˈoʊkənˌʌt ˈɔɪl, dɹˈɪl ɐ dɹˈeɪn, ˈæd ɐ ɹˈoʊp.

lines.text: A plant shop pays ₹199: revenue, not profit.
lines.tts: A plant shop pays a hundred and ninety-nine rupees: revenue, not profit.
lines.phonemes: ɐ plˈænt ʃˈɑːp pˈeɪz ɐ hˈʌndɹɪd ænd nˈaɪntinˈaɪn ɹˈuːpiːz: ɹˈɛvənˌuː, nˌɑːt pɹˈɑːfɪt.

lines.text: After shell, oil, rope, tools and labour, about ₹70 is left.
lines.tts: After shell, oil, rope, tools and labor, about seventy rupees is left.
lines.phonemes: ˈæftɚ ʃˈɛl, ˈɔɪl, ɹˈoʊp, tˈuːlz ænd lˈeɪbɚ, ɐbˌaʊt sˈɛvənti ɹˈuːpiːz ɪz lˈɛft.

lines.text: The finish is what the buyer pays for.
lines.phonemes: ðə fˈɪnɪʃ ɪz wʌt ðə bˈaɪɚ pˈeɪz fɔːɹ.

lines.text: Join WastePaisa and put your scrap to use.
lines.phonemes: dʒˈɔɪn wˈeɪst pˈaɪsɑː ænd pˌʊt jʊɹ skɹˈæp tə jˈuːz.
